sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November looking to extend their excellent form. Currently top of the table with 37 points from 17 games, Sandbach have won their last two league matches and sit 3 points clear. Stafford themselves are in respectable form with one win in their last two, making this a significant mid-table clash for both sides.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, who are unbeaten in their last six league matches, host Dawley Town on Saturday before travelling to face New Mills on Tuesday in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in strong form, welcome struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday. The Saturday fixture list also features Allscott Heath (eighth, riding a three-game winning streak) hosting Crewe, Barnton (seventh, unbeaten in five league games) visiting Eccleshall (fifth), Brereton Social hosting Alsager Town (both in the bottom half), Telford Town facing Widnes Town (the two lowest-placed sides), and Wednesfield Community meeting Shawbury United. On Tuesday, Wednesfield Community visit improving Barnton, while Widnes Town travel to Allscott Heath in what promises to be a challenging fixture for the struggling visitors.
